CREATE TRIGGER equipment_stock_insert BEFORE INSERT ON equipment WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments WHERE equipmentId=NEW.id AND isActive=1) AND (NEW.ownedQuantity IS NULL OR NEW.ownedQuantity<1 OR (NEW.type!='RADIO' AND NEW.ownedQuantity<(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM assignments WHERE equipmentId=NEW.id AND isActive=1))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Insufficient owned stock'); END

CREATE TRIGGER equipment_stock_update BEFORE UPDATE ON equipment WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assignments WHERE equipmentId=NEW.id AND isActive=1) AND (NEW.ownedQuantity IS NULL OR NEW.ownedQuantity<1 OR (NEW.type!='RADIO' AND NEW.ownedQuantity<(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM assignments WHERE equipmentId=NEW.id AND isActive=1))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Insufficient owned stock'); END

CREATE TRIGGER assignments_stock_insert BEFORE INSERT ON assignments WHEN NEW.isActive=1 AND (COALESCE((SELECT ownedQuantity FROM equipment WHERE id=NEW.equipmentId),0)<1 OR ((SELECT type FROM equipment WHERE id=NEW.equipmentId)!='RADIO' AND NEW.quantity+(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM assignments WHERE equipmentId=NEW.equipmentId AND isActive=1 AND id!=NEW.id)>(SELECT ownedQuantity FROM equipment WHERE id=NEW.equipmentId))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Insufficient available stock'); END

CREATE TRIGGER assignments_stock_update BEFORE UPDATE ON assignments WHEN NEW.isActive=1 AND (COALESCE((SELECT ownedQuantity FROM equipment WHERE id=NEW.equipmentId),0)<1 OR ((SELECT type FROM equipment WHERE id=NEW.equipmentId)!='RADIO' AND NEW.quantity+(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) FROM assignments WHERE equipmentId=NEW.equipmentId AND isActive=1 AND id!=NEW.id)>(SELECT ownedQuantity FROM equipment WHERE id=NEW.equipmentId))) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Insufficient available stock'); END
